description: This Java class defines the entity 'ScheduledJobDetail' for representing scheduled job details within the Fineract infrastructure, including properties like job name, display name, cron expression, status flags, and an update method for modifying its properties based on JSON commands.

classes.name: ScheduledJobDetail
classes.description: Entity class representing details of a scheduled job, including properties for job identification, scheduling, status, and an update method for applying changes from JSON commands.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the properties of the ScheduledJobDetail instance based on the provided JsonCommand, tracking and returning the actual changes made.
